# Checklist

- [ ] I understand and agree to the [Code of Conduct](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html).
- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`fix:`, `feat:`, `docs:`, ...); it becomes the `NEWS.md` entry.
- [ ] I have run `air format .` and `jarl check .`.
- [ ] I have updated roxygen comments and run `devtools::document()` if documentation changed.
- [ ] I have added [`testthat`](https://testthat.r-lib.org) unit tests to `tests/testthat` for any new functionality or fixed bug.
